<PAGE><BLOCK>title<LEVEL1>[327, 72, 740, 105]<FORK>SPECIAL POWER OF ATTORNEY
<BLOCK>text[368, 103, 680, 128]<FORK>No. POA-2625-405-2025 01 April 2025
<BLOCK>text[128, 151, 923, 238]<FORK>Dolce Group International S.A., a société anonyme incorporated under the laws of the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg, with registered office at 5, Rue des Noisetiers, L-1855 Luxembourg, Grand Duchy of Luxembourg (RCS Luxembourg 6 41 207) (the "Principal"), represented by Mariam Al Sunaidi, Head of Legal, duly authorised by resolution of the board of directors.
<BLOCK>text[122, 220, 920, 327]<FORK>hereby appoints Hassan Nafim and Rania Fakhoury of Najm & Co. Advocates, Office 2104; Al Wasl Business Tower, Sheikh Zayed Road, Dubai, UAE, jointly or severally (the "Attorneys") to act in its name and on its behalf in Sultanate of Oman in all matters concerning the protection and enforcement of its trademarks, including the VÉLORA mark (registration No. 114361), and in particular in matter TM-2025-405 against velora-outlet.shop (registrant), with the following powers:
<BLOCK>text[122, 308, 914, 364]<FORK>a) to represent the Principal before all courts of every degree, the public prosecution, police, customs, economic and municipal authorities and the trademark office;
<BLOCK>text[120, 342, 914, 401]<FORK>b) to file, sign and withdraw complaints, statements of claim, appeals, oppositions and applications for precautionary seizure;
<BLOCK>text[118, 379, 925, 432]<FORK>c) to appoint and challenge experts, attend inspections and the destruction of goods, and receive notices;
<BLOCK>text[116, 416, 911, 470]<FORK>d) to negotiate and sign settlements and undertakings, and to receive amounts awarded or agreed and give receipts;
<BLOCK>text[115, 451, 601, 485]<FORK>e) to 'delegate all or part of these powers to another lawyer.
<BLOCK>text[112, 473, 907, 528]<FORK>This power of attorney is valid until 01 April 2028 unless revoked earlier in writing. It is governed by the laws of Sultanate of Oman.
<BLOCK>text[112, 515, 264, 537]<FORK>For the Principal
<BLOCK>image[300, 540, 401, 616]<FORK>
<BLOCK>text[110, 627, 335, 679]<FORK>Mariam Al Suwaidi
Head of Legal
Dolce Group International S.A.
